types.label: Auto-lander paused
types.description: The auto-lander was paused (from the Auto-lander tab, the CLI, MCP or voice): nothing new lands until it is resumed. Resolved when it resumes.

types.label: PR held by the gate
types.description: A PR waiting to land fails a gate rule and needs a fix (red CI, a failing check, a code clash, UI Review changes). Once per PR and rule; resolved when it passes or leaves the line.
